svg.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif, Apple Color Emoji, Segoe UI Emoji, Noto Color Emoji
svg.title: A CR is a folder that moves
svg.desc: A change request is one folder of Markdown files in .agents/changes/; its life is that folder moving from stage to stage, never copied, and gaining files on the way. A request from the intake (a Jira issue, a GitLab or GitHub issue, the chat, a Markdown file, or QA and retro findings) is converted to Markdown and filed with chantier file into 1-inbox/<slug>/, with intake/ as received and 01-intent.md, the request summarised; 02-answers.md holds your answers if you are grilled, 03-change-spec.md the spec; they are written with you by the Chief of Staff, or by a Griller (optional, another session of yours). chantier triage moves a CR to 2-backlog/P1…P4/<slug>/; nothing new, you set its priority. chantier triage --ready moves a CR from 1-inbox or 2-backlog to 3-ready/<slug>/, where it waits for the next batch, specified or automatable. To start its implementation, chantier open moves it into the batch, 4-batch/1-pending/<number>-<slug>/, where it gains STATUS.md and STATUS.json, written by the CLI; chantier take moves it to 2-actives/ when a Driver takes it, where it gains work/, written while it runs: notes, gate logs, the PR body, and for a release CR retro.md and fix-<n>.md; and evidence/, the Verifier's proofs. Once its PR or MR is merged, chantier order merged moves it to 3-done/. When the batch is closed, chantier close moves it to 5-archives/<YYMMDD-HHMM>-<number>-<slug>/, where it gains delivery.md (the PR and the merge time); the batch's record and retro are kept in 5-archives/batches/batch-NN.json and batch-NN.md. At any stage before the archive, chantier order drop moves it to 6-trash/, with its work.
svg.text: 📁 A CR is a folder that moves

Folder moves from stage to stage, never copied, gaining files on the way.
